methode: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.

methode: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.

methode: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.
